diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster` declares `depends_on = [aws_eks_cluster.this[0], ...]`, but its `local-exec` provisioner already sets `environment = { ENDPOINT = aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint }`, which creates the identical implicit dependency (it is listed in the node's `implicit_deps`). The `aws_eks_cluster.this` entry in `depends_on` can be removed; only `aws_security_group_rule.cluster_private_access` is a genuinely explicit dependency.
